findings: The textbook dates Berzelius' coining of 'protein' to 1938; Berzelius died in 1848 and the term dates from 1838. The lesson omits the year and records the printed error here.
The sickle-cell sequence in the figure (Val-His-Leu-Thr-Pro-Glu-Glu) is the standard first seven residues of the beta chain, added for illustration; the textbook names only position six.
The printed sentence 'The remaining nine amino acids cannot make our bodies on its own' is read as 'cannot be made by our bodies'.
